channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Rutland Town Select Board unanimously agreed to support the Walmart supercenter project. They will speak at the December first Act two fifty hearing about economic impacts. Walmart plans to move from downtown Rutland City to the former Diamond Run Mall site.
Rutland City is searching for a site to establish an emergency shelter. This effort aims to support vulnerable residents in need. The city is prioritizing this initiative to enhance local resources.

North Country Ministry expanded emergency assistance into southern Essex County towns like Skroon Lake and Ticonderoga. Funded by a one hundred fifty thousand dollar grant, it helps families with fuel, housing, and utilities. Caseworkers travel to food pantries to reduce transportation barriers for residents.

Grocery stores in New England are struggling to stock shelves as a New Hampshire warehouse strike enters its third week. One store in Saxtons River even temporarily closed due to lack of groceries. The strike is impacting food availability across the region.
